panel.title: Help
quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.step1: Create a connection — click the + button in the sidebar to add Modbus TCP, MQTT, or OPC UA.
quickstart.step2: Add tags — select your connection and define the data points you want to monitor.
quickstart.step3: Start monitoring — click Connect to begin reading real-time data from your devices.
protocols.title: Protocol Guides
protocols.modbus.title: Modbus TCP
protocols.modbus.desc: Industrial standard for PLC communication. Supports holding registers, input registers, coils, and discrete inputs. Default port: 502.
protocols.mqtt.title: MQTT
protocols.mqtt.desc: Lightweight messaging protocol for IoT. Subscribe to topics and receive real-time data from MQTT brokers. Supports QoS levels 0, 1, and 2.
protocols.opcua.title: OPC UA
protocols.opcua.desc: Platform-independent standard for industrial data exchange. Browse node hierarchies and subscribe to real-time data changes.
